name: Chapel
text: A small ruined chapel sits underground.

pass.text: You find a small offering plate with gold.

fail.text: All the candles suddenly go out and you flee the room in terror.

name: Crypt
text: Rows of stone coffins line the walls of this room.

pass.text: A shovel sits in the corner of the room. It seems to be stained with something red.

fail.text: One of the coffins begins to open. You run.

name: Dining Hall
text: A long cracked wooden table sits in the middle of the room. Every chair is empty.

pass.text: You find a wooden fighting spoon under the table.

fail.text: One of the chairs slowly pulls itself away from the table as you exit the room.

name: Garden
text: Twisted plants somehow grow beneath the stone ceiling in this room, despite the lack of sunlight.

pass.text: You find a small silver dagger among the roots.

fail.text: A vine moves to wrap around your foot as you flee.

name: Workshop
text: Tools and unfinished projects cover the workbenches and shelves in this room.

pass.text: You find a pitchfork mounted on the wall.

fail.text: You accidentally activate one of the machines as you leave the room.

pass.text: You search carefully and find a rusty helmet hidden beneath the floorboards.

fail.text: You spend far too long searching before realizing there really is nothing here. You exit the room.

name: Fountain
text: An old stone fountain filled with shimmering water sits in the centre of the room.

pass.text: You manage to retrieve a jester's pipe from the bottom of the fountain.

fail.text: Something touches your hand before you jerk it away and run off.

name: Supply Room
text: Crates of rotten food create a horrible stench in this room.

pass.text: Among the spoiled supplies you find a sack of potatoes.

fail.text: You projectile vomit on your way out of the room.

name: Barracks
text: Much of the supplies seem to have been cleared out long ago.

pass.text: A rusty claymore still hangs above the door.

fail.text: You don't find anything of use. You think you hear footsteps approaching.
